claim: grounded 88% vs closed-book 69% = +19pt grounding lift (n=8, keyword grader, no control)
verdict: NOT RESOLVED — the intervals overlap heavily and the lift is 1.5 items

grader_sensitivity.implication: A single mis-graded item moves an n=8 arm by 12.5 points, and roughly one mis-grade per arm is EXPECTED at the keyword grader's measured accuracy. The claimed +19pt lift is inside the noise the grader alone introduces.

what_would_fix_it: the hedge-aware grader (98.9% measured) instead of keyword (88.0%)
a control arm — the same test on the UNTRAINED base, to separate 'the KB helps' from 'this model reads context well'
what_is_NOT_disputed: The DIRECTION is plausible and the per-item pattern is suggestive — AI-generated-images 0%->100% and register 50%->100% are the cases where grounding should help most. This is a well-designed pilot. It is not yet a measurement.
why_this_matters_here: The 'out-ground not out-think' thesis is the estate's central claim. It is the LAST claim that should rest on n=8 with a grader measured at 88% and no control — those three conditions produced four withdrawn conclusions today.
